TEXT: [FI] After that, Saori and I attempted to take over her fiancé's place.
[FI] Ultimately, I was treated like a suspicious person, and it all ended with the police being called.
[FI] Saori's quick wit ended up saving me, but when I came home, my father was none too pleased.
[FI] Since that day, I haven't been able to contact Saori...
[FI] Too bad! This is the end of The Tale of Kyousuke!
